---
title: "Ablation Study: Orben 2019 (NHB)"
format: pdf
---

```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

```{r orben-helpers}
expand_y_variable <- function(mv, dim_prefix = "mv_dim_",
                               col = "mv_dim_y_variable") {
  if (!col %in% names(mv)) return(mv)

  all_vars <- sort(unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(mv[[col]]), ",")))))

  for (v in all_vars) {
    new_col <- paste0(dim_prefix, "y_", v)
    mv[[new_col]] <- as.integer(
      sapply(strsplit(as.character(mv[[col]]), ",\\s*"), function(x) v %in% trimws(x))
    )
  }

  mv |> select(-all_of(col))
}
```

This document contains the ablation studies for the three multiverse datasets
from Orben & Przybylski (2019, *Nature Human Behaviour*): MCS Total, MTF, and
YRBS.  For each dataset, every decision is fixed to one option in turn,
importance estimates are recomputed on the reduced multiverse, and the
resulting importance vectors are compared across methods and across options of
the fixed decision.

---

# MCS Total

```{r mcs-load-data}
mv_mcs <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mcs_total") |>
  expand_y_variable()
```

## Ablation Study

```{r mcs-ablation-run}
ablation_mcs <- run_ablation_analysis(mv_mcs, colname_metric = "effect")
```

### Inter-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
vis_inter_method_stability(ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Intra-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-plot}
vis_intra_method_stability(ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary)
```
